# semaphore_ex_global_policy_guardrail_test (Ephemeral Resource)

Evaluates or compares policy guardrails without publishing or saving a policy. Opening this ephemeral resource evaluates the preview; results are not persisted in Terraform state. LDAP/OIDC previews record server-side reconciliation history. No automatic apply, renewal or deletion of audit history is performed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
ephemeral "semaphore_ex_global_policy_guardrail_test" "example" {
  source_yaml = yamlencode({ version = 1, rules = [] })
  input       = { project_id = 1, intent = "task", evaluated_at = "2026-09-21T12:00:00Z", template = { id = 2, application = "ansible", source = "task" }, executor = { type = "local", image_reference_kind = "none" } }
}

# Reference ephemeral.semaphore_ex_global_policy_guardrail_test.example.result in an ephemeral context.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `input` (Dynamic) Value-free PolicyGuardrailEvaluationInput: project_id, intent, evaluated_at, template/workflow, runner, executor and credential-reference metadata. No credentials or executable payloads.
- `source_yaml` (String) Authored YAML to evaluate against the supplied fixture; this endpoint does not load active policy.

### Read-Only

- `result` (Dynamic, Sensitive) Complete native result, excluding any preview token. It is ephemeral and never stored in Terraform state. Sensitive because results may describe identity or execution metadata.
